basic_info.description: Welcome to 2470 17th Avenue, a stunning San Francisco residence offering timeless elegance and comfort. This beautifully crafted home upstairs features 2 spacious bedrooms and a refined bathroom, all within 1,200 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Graceful architectural details and abundant natural light create an inviting ambiance. Enjoy freshly painted and refinished hardwood floors throughout.  The downstairs area offers extra storage, plus an office and den with a wet bar, perfect for entertaining. Conveniently located near shopping and dining options. Experience the allure of this exquisite home today. Don't miss out on this cozy home located in the sunset prime location!
